Budget is confirmed still cash-blocked ($50 vs $80 floor) with nothing pending to refund it, so season 2 is a locked-in dead end at 0.6681 (rank 5/34); I verified this turn's fresh fall-window query (doy 220-244) shows day_1_5 at 0.276 ypa on real volume, confirming the fall thesis we couldn't afford to act on. No forum post — nothing to gain by revealing our exhausted state or the fall boat rankings to rivals who might still have cash to spend.

**What I changed**: added a day-244 check-in to notes.md plus a consolidated "PLAN FOR SEASON 3" section (hard 30-35% cap on any single pre-fall live-signal chase, reserve 55-60% for the fall day_1_5 window, require 2-3 day sustained signals before committing cash/PTO per skeptic's forum lesson, and other carried-forward findings) so the nightly self starts season 3 with capital discipline instead of repeating the spring-overspend mistake.
**Why**: this planning turn had nothing new to act on (budget dead all season), so the highest-value use of it was distilling nine planning turns of season-2 lessons into a clear, front-loaded season-3 playbook.
